prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity LIGHT-THEME desktop mockup of the MAIN INBOX OVERVIEW in KasiTek Growth, landscape 1600x1000. Input image1 is the existing functional layout to preserve: a page header, full-width CHANNEL TABS beneath it, left conversation list, and large unselected-conversation pane. Input image2 is visual STYLE ONLY: clean Geist typography, neutral white surfaces, subtle grey sidebar, fine regular outline icons and restrained blue. The previous mockup missed the channel tabs. This new version MUST prominently include the entire channel tab bar, not replace it with a dropdown.

Flat front-on screenshot, no device frame, no browser chrome, no perspective. Attio/Twenty-like precision, Geist-like 13px body, dark #191B1F text, secondary #62686F, white #FFFFFF canvas, fine #E8EAED separators, faint gray #F7F8F9 secondary surface, blue #2569D2 accent. No purple surfaces, gradients, glows, giant KPI cards, oversized rounded cards, marketing copy, illustrations or cartoon robots.

LEFT PRODUCT SIDEBAR 220px: small black square K and Growth at top; workspace KasiTek; quick search. Groups Home (Overview, Agents), Customer (Inbox selected, Calls, Contacts, Bookings), Content (Posts, Calendar, Analytics), Campaigns (Campaigns, Templates), Manage (Connections). Settings and Enock avatar at bottom. Consistent regular Phosphor-style fine outline icons. Same navigation styling as image2.

MAIN CONTENT: compact 52px top bar has breadcrumb Growth / Inbox, search and notifications/avatar. Page heading 'Inbox' on left, outlined 'Manage channels' button on right. NO subtitle. Immediately below page heading, a visually clear full-width horizontal channel tab row, with small recognizable brand icons and exact labels: 'All conversations 12' (selected, blue underline), 'WhatsApp 6', 'Email 3', 'SMS' (muted disabled), 'Instagram 2', 'Messenger 1'. All SIX tabs visible and neatly spaced on one line. The bar spans the entire main content above BOTH conversation-list pane and reading pane. Do not hide these tabs or use an All channels dropdown.

Below tabs: thin vertical separator divides a 330px conversation list and the remaining large message pane. List header 'Conversations' at left, muted '12' at right. Below it compact search 'Search conversations…'. Tiny segmented filters 'All' selected, 'Unread', 'Starred'. Compact polished real-looking example conversation rows, faint separators, softinitial avatars: Thandi Mokoena / 'Can I move my appointment to Friday?' /10:24 /tiny WhatsApp icon and unread dot; Sipho Dlamini /'Do you have availability next week?'/09:17 /WhatsApp; Naledi Jacobs /'Thanks, that works for me.'/Yesterday /Email; Kabelo Molefe /'Can I get a quote for 50 T-shirts?'/Yesterday /Instagram; Priya Naidoo /'What are your trading hours?'/Tue /Messenger. A few more quiet rows continuing below. No row selected; no customer detail drawer yet.

READING PANE: clean white empty-selection state, modest small fine speechbubble icon at optical center, title 'Select a conversation' in 15px medium and one restrained short line 'View messages and reply'. No fake analytics or recommendation cards. Reading pane is spacious and calm; this is the actual overview before choosing a conversation. No composer until a conversation is selected. Deliberately refined layout, crisp legible text, consistent vertical rhythm and subtle edge treatments. Inactive SMS is unavailable, not enabled. Illustrative accounts/counts only, no suggestion of new capabilities. Ensure this reads as the overview of the same Inbox as image2, with a clear channel hierarchy above the message panes.
